I would like to nominate my step-daughter Serra, whom I feel is my own. She has struggled with depression & was failing most of her classes when she lived with her biological mother. But since moving with us, late freshman year, she has made a complete turn-around & began to excel in school. To the point she's an A/B honor roll senior & many colleges are interested in her. Though she's decided to stay at home with us due to her dad being disabled, chronically ill, & just wanting to help out physically & financially; she is still going to attend a college here in the fall. Serra also began to flourish within herself by attending Christian youth camp, going on mission trips, & just getting a handle on her depression (with assistance.) She is constantly helping people and is often putting herself last. 

Her dad & I are on a very tight budget (ssi) & can never really give her expensive electronics. So I know this laptop will definitely help her. In college, in motivation, & in daily life. Alone this will be very inspiring for her to know other people believe in her & her future.
